title: $2$-designs admitting a flag-transitive automorphism group with socle $PSL(2,q)$
summary: $2$-designs admitting a flag-transitive automorphism group $G$ with socle $PSL(2,q)$, where $q=p^{f}\geq 4$, are investigated in both the point-primitive and point-imprimitive cases. In the latter case, a complete classification is achieved, and three known examples occur, namely: the complementary designs of $PG(3,2)$ and $PG(3,4)$, and the $2$-$(36,8,4)$ design constructed by Devillers and Praeger in [14].
